configuration_id: FILL: short id of the selected Gemma configuration, e.g. brian-gemma4-e4b-<cut>

sources.ref: FILL: path, PID, or lab_answers.md anchor

implementation.name: FILL
implementation.framework: FILL: e.g. pytorch+transformers | vllm | llama.cpp | other (describe)

entry_points.edge: FILL: script or module the DGX Spark runs
entry_points.server: FILL: script or module the server runs

model.dtype_edge: FILL: as loaded on the edge, e.g. bfloat16
model.dtype_server: FILL: as loaded on the server
model.checkpoint_note: FILL only if the server directory is not named gemma-4-E4B-it: why it is the same checkpoint

kv_cache.shared_kv_handling: FILL if KV-sharing source and consumer layers are on different hosts: how the consumer gets the KV

transport.protocol: FILL: tcp | http | grpc | zmq | other
transport.endpoint: FILL: host:port or URL the edge uses to reach the server
transport.experiment_endpoint: FILL: host:port the experiment's OWN server instance listens on (same protocol and serialisation; a port Brian's running deployment does not use)

uuids: FILL: GPU-... of each server GPU the deployment uses

tuning_history: FILL: was the split point or any setting chosen by measuring performance? when, on which hardware? (context only)

authentication.mechanism: FILL: none | shared token in an environment variable | mTLS | SSH tunnel | other (describe; NEVER a value)

unknowns: FILL: list every field still unknown; the list must be empty for Stage 0 to CONTINUE
